card.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 Plus with Grayed Out WiFi

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 Plus with Grayed Out WiFi

claims.statement: A greyed-out Wi-Fi toggle is a board fault, not an antenna fault; on iPhone 8 Plus it's usually ripped corner pads under the WLAN_W chip, fixed by jumpering pins 19, 20, 22 and 23 to their traces and reballing the original IC.
If the Wi-Fi IC itself is damaged it can be replaced, but it must be unpaired via the NAND, e.g. iRepair P10 in Purple Mode over USB.

procedure: Remove the WLAN_W IC and inspect corner pads.
Reball and refit the original IC (or replace and unbind with iRepair P10).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
